captions.instagram:
One modifier can change what a SwiftUI map helps people notice.

Use `.standard(elevation: .realistic)` when orientation, roads, and labels lead the task. Use `.imagery(elevation: .realistic)` when the physical character of the place matters more. Neither is universally better—the interface should follow the decision the user needs to make.

The snippet is short. The product decision behind it is not. Save the final slide for your next MapKit screen.
